The '''Chagrasi Remnant''' was a region in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] which had formerly been under the control of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Chagras]], as part of the [[Chagras Hegemony]].

==History==
Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Chagras in [[1040 BBY]], most of the systems that Chagras had ruled fell to the control of other [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lords. However, some of the systems held out from the invaders and came to be known as the Chagrasi Remnant. As of [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]] was uncertain as to whether the term "Chagrasi Remnant" referred to an actual Sith power, or just a region that the warring Sith Lords had not conquered.
